title: Social Media Marketing for Beauty Salons: The Ultimate Guide to Filling Your Appointment Book | Bookeo

facts.fact: The search phrase "natural hair salon near me" is searched about 4.7k times a month globally, according to Bookeo's article.
facts.quote: “natural hair salon near me” gets searched about 4.7k times a month globally.

facts.fact: Bookeo states that potential salon clients spend over 17 hours per week on social media, with no source given.
facts.quote: Your potential clients spend over 17 hours per week on social media.

facts.fact: Bookeo cites Douglas J. College's figure that 4.9 billion people use social media platforms worldwide.
facts.quote: With [4.9 billion people using social media platforms worldwide](https://douglasj.edu/why-social-media-is-important-in-the-beauty-industry/)

facts.fact: Bookeo says consumers aged 55 and older account for 30% of the salon market share and spend the most on hair care services.
facts.quote: Consumers aged 55 and older account for 30% of the market share and spend the most on hair care services.

facts.fact: Bookeo says consumers aged 45 to 54 make up 21.9% of the salon market.
facts.quote: Middle-aged consumers aged 45 to 54 make up 21.9% of the market.

facts.fact: Bookeo says consumers aged 25 to 34 represent 16% of the salon market.
facts.quote: Those aged 25 to 34 represent 16% and seek regular haircuts and routine coloring that fit their professional and social lifestyles.

facts.fact: Bookeo says consumers under 25 account for 12.1% of the salon market.
facts.quote: Consumers under 25 account for 12.1% of the market due to limited discretionary spending.

facts.fact: Bookeo reports that 55% of Gen Z rate a social media presence as the biggest factor when deciding where to book.
facts.quote: 55% of Gen Z and 47% of Millennials rate a social media presence as the biggest factor when deciding where to book.

facts.quote: without spending a dollar on the platform itself.

facts.quote: Around 4 in 5 beauty shoppers use Instagram daily.

facts.quote: About 81% of people use Instagram to research a service.

facts.fact: The page states Facebook has over 2.85 billion users.

facts.quote: A client who has seen your brand on Facebook 5 to 10 times before typing “hair salon near me” into Google converts at 2 to 3 times the rate of a cold searcher.

facts.fact: The page states TikTok has over 1 billion monthly active users.
facts.quote: TikTok has over 1 billion monthly active users

facts.fact: The page states beauty is Pinterest's single largest category by search volume, accounting for roughly 1 in 4 searches on the platform.
facts.quote: Beauty is Pinterest’s single largest category by search volume and accounts for roughly 1 in 4 searches on the platform.

facts.fact: The page states Pinterest drives 33% more referral traffic to shopping sites than Facebook.
facts.quote: Pinterest drives 33% more referral traffic to shopping sites than Facebook.

facts.fact: The page states that about 65% of Pinterest users say they come to the platform to shop.
facts.quote: About 65% of pinners say they come to Pinterest to shop

facts.fact: The page states 83% of Pinterest users say they have made a purchase based on content they saw from a brand on the platform.
facts.quote: 83% of pinners say they’ve made a purchase based on content they saw from a brand on the platform.

facts.fact: The page states beauty enthusiasts are 82% more likely to be reached on Pinterest than on other platforms.
facts.quote: You’re 82% more likely to reach a beauty enthusiast on Pinterest versus other platforms

facts.fact: The page states Pinners purchase 80% more beauty products than non-pinners.
facts.quote: while pinners purchase 80% more beauty products versus non-pinners.

facts.fact: The page states Pinterest shoppers have 30% bigger baskets.
facts.quote: shoppers here have 30% bigger baskets too.

facts.fact: The page states before-and-after transformation posts receive 2 to 3 times more engagement than standard posts.
facts.quote: Posts featuring these transformations receive 2 to 3 times more engagement than standard posts.

facts.fact: The page states engagement on transformation posts is 28% higher when user-generated content is included.
facts.quote: Engagement jumps 28% higher when you include user-generated content in these transformations.

facts.fact: Bookeo states that salons posting consistently attract 3 to 5 times more inquiries than those posting sporadically.
facts.quote: Salons that post consistently attract 3 to 5 times more inquiries than those posting sporadically.

facts.fact: Bookeo says most salon owners find three to four Instagram posts weekly and one to two Facebook posts weekly sustainable.
facts.quote: Most salon owners find three to four posts weekly on Instagram and one to two on Facebook sustainable.

facts.fact: Bookeo says batch-creating content proves 3 to 4 times more efficient than creating content one post at a time.
facts.quote: Batching proves 3 to 4 times more efficient than creating content one post at a time.

facts.fact: Bookeo cites platform research listing the best Instagram posting times as Mondays 2 to 4 p.m., Tuesdays 1 to 7 p.m., Wednesdays 12 to 9 p.m., and Thursdays 12 to 2 p.m.
facts.quote: Platform research shows the best times to post on Instagram are Mondays 2 to 4 p.m., Tuesdays 1 to 7 p.m., Wednesdays 12 to 9 p.m., and Thursdays 12 to 2 p.m.

facts.fact: Bookeo states that brands adopting social media booking tools see a 14% lift in total bookings.
facts.quote: Brands that adopt social media booking tools see a 14% lift in total bookings.

facts.fact: Bookeo recommends simplifying the mobile booking flow if it takes longer than 30 seconds or more than three taps.
facts.quote: Test the flow on mobile. Simplify if it takes longer than 30 seconds or more than three taps.

facts.fact: Bookeo states that 76% of people who conduct a local search visit a business within 24 hours.
facts.quote: 76% of people who conduct a local search visit a business within 24 hours.

facts.fact: Bookeo states that Google Business Profiles with photos receive 42% more requests for driving directions.
facts.quote: Profiles with photos receive 42% more requests for driving directions.

facts.fact: Bookeo recommends batching by photographing five to eight transformations in one session and writing captions for the next ten posts in one 45-minute sitting.
facts.quote: Photograph five to eight transformations in one session. Record two to three videos the same day. Write captions for the next ten posts in one 45-minute sitting.

facts.fact: Bookeo recommends short educational video clips of 30 to 45 seconds covering one tip per video.
facts.quote: Format these as short 30- to 45-second clips, covering one tip per video.

facts.fact: Bookeo claims that two high-quality posts weekly outperform seven inconsistent posts.
facts.quote: Two high-quality posts weekly outperform seven inconsistent posts.

facts.fact: Bookeo advises checking peak follower activity in the Instagram or Facebook Insights tab, which requires a business account.
facts.quote: View peak times when your followers are online through Instagram or Facebook’s Insights tab, provided you have a business account.

facts.fact: The page advises setting a 5 to 10 mile radius around the salon for Facebook and Instagram ads.
facts.quote: Set a 5 to 10 mile radius around your salon for Facebook and Instagram ads.

facts.fact: The page advises targeting women aged 21 to 55 who live nearby and show interest in hair care and beauty for salon social ads.
facts.quote: Target women aged 21 to 55 who live nearby and show interest in hair care and beauty.

facts.fact: The page suggests starting Facebook and Instagram ad spend at USD 750 to USD 1,500 per month.
facts.quote: Start with USD 750 to USD 1,500 monthly.

facts.fact: The page cites beauty industry metrics showing a cost per lead of USD 42; this is a third-party benchmark, not Bookeo's own figure.
facts.quote: Beauty industry metrics show USD 42 cost per lead.

facts.fact: The page recommends requesting Google reviews via text within 24 hours of checkout.
facts.quote: Request Google reviews within 24 hours of checkout via text.

facts.fact: The page recommends responding to every online review within 48 hours.
facts.quote: Respond to every review within 48 hours.

facts.fact: The page defines cost per booking as total monthly social media spend divided by the number of confirmed bookings that came from social media.
facts.quote: Calculate it by dividing your total monthly social media spend by the number of confirmed bookings that came from social media.
